comparison.objective: Administer exactly one eye drop while drawing down a manikin lid and avoiding contact; candidate transfers an LM block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record coordinates lid displacement with noncontact bottle aiming and force-controlled squeezing. Candidate coordinates jig alignment and bearing-block sliding with ball containment.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires one correctly placed drop, adequate lid opening, no nozzle/eye contact and bottle return. Candidate requires complete transfer, all balls retained and no interface separation, jam, damage or contamination contact.
comparison.reason: Noncontact liquid dosing and eyelid manipulation are mechanically unrelated to bearing support transfer.
